sql: SELECT fm.id, fm.source, fm.name, fm.group_id, fm.llm_sport_category AS cat, fm.resolution_date::date AS res, (fm.image_url IS NOT NULL) AS img, fm.volume_24h, (SELECT o.name||' '||round(o.current_probability::numeric,3) FROM futures_outcomes o WHERE o.market_id=fm.id AND o.current_probability IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.current_probability DESC LIMIT 1) AS leader, count(*) OVER () AS total FROM futures_markets fm WHERE fm.status='open' AND fm.name ~* '\m(openai|gpt|claude(?!\s+monet)|deepseek|gemini|ai model|best ai)' ORDER BY fm.volume_24h DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 400
